coverage_method: Actual logged production_candidates including both extra student candidates; round-1 values only. Missing legal actions are unscored, not assumed poor. Global omissions only reported when every legal plant was scored. Tied maxima use set overlap.
historical_error: The prior reconstructed subset falsely counted recorded extra-student candidates as omitted. Its omission/regret numbers and causal conclusions are superseded.

task74.roof_levels_42_to_49: all 0/16; all eight levels require expansion

multiplicity: Primary all_plants contrast across all required roof levels; Holm adjustment. No final inference from incomplete pairs.

cluster_inference.assumption: Independent reset-seed clusters with symmetric paired treatment effect under the null; whole-seed swaps across all levels. Exploratory while the panel is incomplete.

pooled_primary.pooled_caveat: Naive pooled McNemar treats level-seed pairs independently; use whole-reset-seed clustered inference and per-level corrected tests for conclusions.
